title: Work Journal header: a Today button, and the other page actions in a menu right of the date
summary: The journal header now shows Previous day, the title, a page-actions menu, Next day and Today; Jump to date, New page, Delete, Report and Pop out moved into a keyboard-friendly menu.
friction: the machine (7.8 GB) ran out of memory when two dev agents ran their full suites at once; both runs were killed mid-gate and cost about 30 minutes; fixed in-run with a gate lock (mkdir C:/git/maestro-wt/gate-lock) so heavy commands run one at a time
the menu opened past the pane edge; happy-dom does no layout so unit tests could not catch it and a review round was spent; the reviewer caught it by rendering the built CSS in headless Edge
lessons_learned: A front-end story that adds a popover should render it with the built styles in a headless browser before the PR opens; unit tests in happy-dom do not check layout
